extracted.intended_audience: Prospective NEH grant applicants (humanities scholars, faculty, staff, and organizations seeking NEH funding)
extracted.subtask_description: Overview of National Endowment for the Humanities grant programs and the kinds of projects each program supports (e.g., digital public projects, faculty awards at HSIs/HBCUs, media and public humanities projects). Intended to help applicants identify program fit and deadlines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Digital Projects for the Public — project focus
rubrics_metrics.description: Supports projects that interpret and analyze humanities content in primarily digital platforms and formats, such as websites, mobile applications and tours, and virtual environments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Anchors eligibility/fit on projects that center humanities interpretation/analysis delivered primarily through digital platforms (examples given: websites, mobile apps and tours, virtual environments). No scoring details provided on the page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Digital Humanities Advancement Grants — lifecycle support
rubrics_metrics.description: Supports digital projects throughout their lifecycles, from early start-up phases through implementation and long-term sustainability.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Program emphasis is on digital-project lifecycle stages (start-up, implementation, sustainability). Use this to determine whether a digital project’s stage aligns with this program; no further evaluation criteria shown on this page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Awards for Faculty at Hispanic-Serving Institutions — applicant & project fit
rubrics_metrics.description: Supports individual faculty or staff members at Hispanic-Serving Institutions pursuing research of value to humanities scholars, students, or general audiences.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Criterion highlights: applicant affiliation (HSI) and research that has demonstrable value to humanities scholars, students, or general audiences. Page does not list application requirements or scoring rubric here.

rubrics_metrics.name: Awards for Faculty at Historically Black Colleges and Universities — applicant & project fit
rubrics_metrics.description: Supports individual faculty or staff members at Historically Black Colleges and Universities (HBCUs) pursuing research of value to humanities scholars, students, or general audiences.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Criterion highlights: applicant affiliation (HBCU) plus research value to humanities scholars, students, or general audiences. No further evaluative guidance is provided on this landing page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public Humanities Projects (Division of Public Programs) — program listing
rubrics_metrics.description: Listed as a featured program with upcoming deadline (January 9, 2019) under Division of Public Programs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is a program identifier and deadline notice; the page does not include the program’s detailed acceptance criteria or evaluation standards here.

rubrics_metrics.name: Media Projects: Production Grants — program listing
rubrics_metrics.description: Listed as a featured program with upcoming deadline (January 9, 2019) for production grants in the Media Projects category.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Program name and deadline only on this page; specific evaluation criteria (e.g., narrative quality, audience reach, technical competence) are not provided here.

rubrics_metrics.name: Media Projects: Development Grants — program listing
rubrics_metrics.description: Listed as a featured program with upcoming deadline (January 9, 2019) for development grants in the Media Projects category.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Page provides program name and deadline only; detailed standards for proposal review are not included on this landing page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Information for First-time Applicants — resource signpost
rubrics_metrics.description: A navigation link aimed at providing guidance to first-time NEH applicants.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Signposts that NEH offers targeted resources for new applicants but does not present the content or criteria from that resource on this page.

rubrics_metrics.name: NEH's Application Review Process — resource signpost
rubrics_metrics.description: A navigation link to information about NEH’s application review process.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates that NEH has a formal review process (likely containing evaluation criteria), but the landing page does not reproduce those review criteria; applicants should consult the linked review-process page for scoring and evaluation details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Become a Peer Reviewer — program/resource signpost
rubrics_metrics.description: A navigation link inviting qualified individuals to serve as NEH peer reviewers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Signals that peer review is used in NEH evaluation; no reviewer standards or review criteria are provided on this page itself.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examples of Projects Funded — illustrative examples
rubrics_metrics.description: Showcases funded projects (e.g., 'Archibald Motley: Jazz Age Modernist', 'Poetry and Prayer: Islamic Manuscripts from the Walters', 'Chasing Dreams: Baseball & Becoming American').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These examples illustrate the kinds of humanities projects NEH has funded (topic diversity, public-facing scholarship) and can help applicants infer program fit; no explicit evaluative rubric is provided with the examples.
